body.condition: For every \(K\), \(c\in\mathcal C\), and \(1\le f\le L\), conditional on the training sample outside \(\mathcal V_{cf}\), the path \(u\mapsto R_{cf}(u\mid X_{ci})\) is of bounded variation on \([0,\max_{1\le\ell\le d_c}t_{c\ell}]\) for \(P_c\)-almost every \(X_{ci}\), almost surely over the training sample.
